comment: The narration, in the order it is spoken. `at` is the second it starts and must line up with a beat in SCENES (Demo.tsx). Edit the words here, then run `npm run voice`.

lines.text: Someone asks about a service you shipped last spring.
You know it exists. You don't remember the number.
This is MeetHint. It listens, and searches what you brought.
So when the question comes, you get the fact, and the file and line it came from.
A repo. A contract. A deck. Any room, same engine.
And when your material doesn't cover it, MeetHint says nothing.
No guessing. That's the whole point.
MeetHint. Join the private beta, at meethint dot A I.
